text: For m2-fixed N=128 seeds 22 and 23 on data_seed 0, is force gain per decade of val_mse_ratio decline from step 12000 to 24000 about 0.025 in both seeds (here 0.019 over 0.78 decades)? If so, does extrapolating it put N=128 force within 0.04 of N=64 only at val_mse_ratio far below any reachable value? That would make the 'ceiling' a practically fixed slope offset rather than a hard limit.
